```{r}
#| label: inject-carb-data
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
if (carb_ready) {
  carb_for_js <- carb_data |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      code = code_commune,
      tot  = round(carb_hab_total, 2)
    )
  carb_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(carb_for_js, auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null")
  pal_js    <- jsonlite::toJSON(c("#F5F2EC", "#DDD8B3", "#B8AE6E",
                                  "#7E743E", "#42391A"))
  cat('<script>\n',
      'window.carbRaw = ', as.character(carb_json), ';\n',
      'window.carbPalette = ', as.character(pal_js), ';\n',
      'window.carbData = {};\n',
      'window.carbRaw.forEach(function(r) { window.carbData[r.code] = r; });\n',
      'window.updateCarbPanel = function(code) {\n',
      '  var el = document.getElementById("carb-content");\n',
      '  if (!el) return;\n',
      '  var d = window.carbData[code];\n',
      '  var elec = window.communeLookup && window.communeLookup[code];\n',
      '  var nom = elec ? elec.nom_commune : code;\n',
      '  var dept = elec ? (elec.libelle_dept + " (" + elec.code_dept + ")") : "";\n',
      '  if (!d) {\n',
      '    el.innerHTML = \'<div class="cp-header"><h3>\' + nom + \'</h3><div class="cp-meta">\' + dept + \' · \' + code + \'</div></div><div class="dvf-empty">Pas d\\\'estimation publiée pour cette commune.</div>\';\n',
      '    return;\n',
      '  }\n',
      '  function fmt(x) { if (x == null) return "—"; return Number(x).toFixed(2); }\n',
      '  el.innerHTML = \'<div class="cp-header"><h3>\' + nom + \'</h3><div class="cp-meta">\' + dept + \' · \' + code + \'</div></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-section"><h4>Empreinte carbone (approche conso)</h4>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-kvs">\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-kv"><span>Par habitant</span><span class="cp-num">\' + fmt(d.tot) + \' tCO₂eq/an</span></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'</div>\' +\n',
      '    \'<p style="font-size:0.78rem;color:#7A7A7A;margin-top:8px;">Estimation macroéconomique RARE/CITEPA — produits consommés par les ménages. Médiane France ≈ 7,9 tCO₂eq/hab. Cible Accord de Paris : 2 t/hab d\\\'ici 2050.</p>\' +\n',
      '    \'</div>\';\n',
      '};\n',
      '</script>\n',
      sep = ""
  )
}
```


## Row {height="82%"}

::: {.card title="Empreinte carbone par habitant · approche consommation" width="72%"}
```{r}
#| label: map-carb
if (carb_ready) {
  vals0 <- carb_data |>
    dplyr::transmute(code_commune, value = carb_hab_total)
  m <- choropleth_socio(com_metro_only, dep_metro, vals0,
                        palette = c("#F5F2EC", "#DDD8B3", "#B8AE6E",
                                    "#7E743E", "#42391A"),
                        legend_title = "tCO₂eq/hab/an",
                        value_unit   = "t",
                        value_fmt    = function(x) format(round(x, 2), nsmall = 2))
  m |>
    htmlwidgets::onRender(
      "function(el, x) {
         window.carbMap = this;
         var self = this;
         this.on('click', function(e) {
           if (e.layer && e.layer.options && e.layer.options.layerId) {
             if (window.updateCarbPanel) window.updateCarbPanel(e.layer.options.layerId);
           }
         });
         function attach() {
           self.eachLayer(function(layer) {
             if (layer.options && layer.options.layerId && !layer._carbClickOn) {
               layer._carbClickOn = true;
               layer.on('click', function(e) {
                 if (window.updateCarbPanel) window.updateCarbPanel(e.target.options.layerId);
               });
             }
           });
         }
         setTimeout(attach, 60);
         setTimeout(attach, 500);
         setTimeout(attach, 2000);
         self.on('layeradd', function() { setTimeout(attach, 0); });
       }"
    )
} else {
  htmltools::HTML("<p style='padding:2rem;color:#7A7A7A;'>Empreinte carbone non chargée. Lancer <code>Rscript scripts/13_energie_carbone.R</code>.</p>")
}
```
:::
